Operating plan

Two weeks designed to produce evidence.

Days 1–3 · Validate the system

Confirm tracking, consent capture, form-to-intake speed, deduplication, call handling, and channel delivery before interpreting performance.

Days 4–7 · Read signal quality

Compare creative, query, geography, device, qualification, and attorney-review outcomes—not just cost per form fill.

Days 8–11 · Shift deliberately

Move bounded budget toward sources producing better qualified-case signals. Retire clear waste without resetting every test.

Days 12–14 · Package the learning

Document what generated volume, what generated qualified inquiries, what attorneys accepted, and what the next sprint should test.

Launch gates

Human approval remains in the loop.

Before media spend

Legal approval of claims and disclosures; final participating-firm identity; state and audience rules; privacy and consent text; call and form QA; destination and tracking checks.

Before optimization feedback

Define the accepted qualification event, confirm deduplication, suppress sensitive details from ad platforms, and verify that downstream outcomes join to the original lead ID.
